summary: Found six root causes in the CI logs (local-timezone today(), set-order tie in choose_bin, shallow-copied settings defaults, shared export spool file, rate-table cache key, month-end review date) and fixed them in /app/stockroom, plus a few hardening fixes (integer billable weight, transfer quantity check, stricter settings/regex validation). All 90 tests pass, and replaying every non-cancelled logged run with its seed, hash seed, timezone and clock now gives no failures; the old unit-conversion failures came from 2.6.0 code and the two cancelled runs are not filed.
